$comment: Evidence map for Phase 36. Current executable coverage proves scoped memory/context safety; durable memory stores, knowledge persistence and governed forgetting remain declared.

areas.area: Memory recall is category, classification and tenant scoped
areas.requirement: Memory access rejects disallowed categories or classifications and permits only requests within declared scope.

evidence.contains: rejects access to a category outside the allowlist
rejects access above the maximum allowed classification
allows access within category and classification limits

areas.area: Memory writes preserve provenance and mark derived inference
areas.requirement: Empty or unauthorized persistent writes fail, while inference memory records its originating agent and provenance kind.

evidence.contains: rejects persistent write when not permitted
marks inference memory with the originating agent

areas.area: Context packages require purpose, budget and provenance
areas.requirement: Context assembly rejects empty task summaries and invalid budgets, while valid packages preserve source provenance.

evidence.contains: builds a valid context package and records provenance

areas.area: Memory/context trust prevents prompt injection and authority confusion
areas.requirement: System instructions may be trusted, external content and raw tool output are not instructions, and user content conflicting with policy is rejected.

evidence.contains: never trusts external content as instructions
never trusts raw tool output as instructions
rejects user content that conflicts with system policy

areas.area: Memory and knowledge remain subordinate to canonical truth
areas.requirement: Memory recall and derived knowledge cannot grant access or replace canonical records owned by the kernel or domain phases.

areas.area: Durable memory stores, knowledge persistence and governed forgetting are wired
areas.requirement: Scoped memory stores, retention/forgetting records, knowledge structures and recall execute at a live authorized boundary with evidence of unreachable forgotten content.
